Exception Safety:

Header file:
#include "ara/crypto/common/trusted_container.h"
Description:
Return the "session" (or "temporary") attribute of an object stored to the container.
Notes:
A "session" object can be stored to a "volatile" container only!
If a "volatile" container keeps a non-session object then it can be saved permanently.
